title: Vegan Spanish Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan Spanish pilaf made with soft, pilaf, and spices.

ingredients.name: soft
ingredients.notes: Any type of soft grain works, such as brown rice or quinoa.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add soft and pilaf to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the pilaf is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
